create.description: Create a new native board; existing files are refused.

open.description: Open a moth/bee/pur board in this session.
open.parameters: path? (or --project); foreign imports need save to a new .moth

save.description: Checkpoint through the native storage worker.

info.description: Inspect z-sorted items, frame/rotated bounds and centers, global board bounds, coordinate conventions, blobs and recovery state.

check.description: Validate the board through the native reader; recovered tails fail.

add.description: Add a local image or explicitly download an HTTP(S) image.
add.parameters: path OR url, at?=[x,y]; omitted at places right of board bounds with a 24-unit gap. Explicit URLs use native bounded HTTP/TLS download. group_origin?=false groups this image with its source folder. The item keeps its source (absolute path or URL) in `source`.

note.description: Add a formatted text note sized to its content.
note.parameters: text, kind?=note|label|list, at?=[x,y]; omitted at places right of board bounds with 24 board-unit gap

stroke.description: Draw a vector pen stroke, marker stroke or arrow.
stroke.parameters: style?=pen|marker|arrow, points=[[x,y],...], width? (board units), color? (0xRRGGBB); CLI uses repeated --point x,y

edit.description: Edit a frame, note, label or content transform.
edit.parameters: id, rect?=[x,y,width,height], text?, name?, transform?={rotation,opacity,grayscale,sampling,note_font_size,note_wrap,note_markup,flip,content_offset,content_scale,content_rotation}; angles in radians, sampling 0..3

layout.description: Arrange images and notes with the GUI layout algorithms.
layout.parameters: mode=horizontal|vertical|grid|optimal, ids?=[], gap?=0 (0..10000; optimal ignores gap), order?=z|name|time|path (path: folders together, numbers by value), count? (horizontal rows / vertical columns)

align.description: Align visible envelopes, distribute or stack.

normalize.description: Match the first z-sorted item, preserving aspect except size.

scale.description: Scale size and positions about the first item.

move.description: Move frames, including members of selected groups.

duplicate.description: Copy items and remap copied group memberships.
duplicate.parameters: delta?=[dx,dy], ids?=[]; omitted delta copies beside board bounds, preserving relative positions and Y; explicit [0,0] duplicates in place

delete.description: Delete explicitly selected subtrees, children first.

group.parameters: ids (nonempty), title?="", color?=0 (0..5 palette or 0x01RRGGBB integer)

ungroup.description: Dissolve selected top-level groups and preserve members.

parent.description: Reparent an item; cycles and excessive nesting are refused.

order.description: Change image/note z-order; group backdrop order is derived.

reset.description: Reset original-backed geometry or match original pixel scale.

undo.description: Undo in a JSON-lines session or batch; history does not survive process exit.

redo.description: Redo in a JSON-lines session or batch; history does not survive process exit.

export.description: Export using the real native renderer; destination must be new.
export.parameters: kind=scene|original|originals|archive, path, ids?=[], side?=2048 (scene longest side), region?=[x,y,width,height]; scene path .png/.svg/.pdf

pixel-info.description: Read original pixel coordinates and image metadata.

capabilities.description: Inspect native protocol and current registered GUI actions.

gamut.description: Measure an image's colors and put a color gamut card beside it, with an arrow to the image. The card keeps its colors if the image is removed.
gamut.parameters: id (image, or a gamut card to measure its image again keeping view/order), view?=windows|cells|shares, sort?=share|warm|light|hue|saturation, at?=[x,y]; colors come from the visible part of the image (crop, rotation, flip); item JSON kind gamut lists colors as {hex, share}

sample.description: Sample a native bounded image preview, without using the clipboard.
sample.parameters: id, point=[x,y] world coordinates; result message is HEX | RGB | HSV (preview sampling, not color managed)

commands.description: List the operation catalog, compiled command names, GUI action coverage and embedded agent guide.

preview.description: Capture a static native preview-bundle/v1 with pixel/board transforms.
preview.parameters: path (bundle root directory), side?=1024; disabled in dry-run

preview-latest.description: Read the latest completed native preview without rendering.
preview-latest.parameters: path (bundle root directory or completed bundle directory)

group-origin.description: Group loose images by their stored origin; preserve existing groups and images with no origin.

snap-grid.description: Snap the first z-sorted selected item or group to grid points on both axes, moving selected members together.
